lines.t: In the quiet of the morning
When the world is barely bright
I feel you in the stillness
Like a whisper made of light
Every shadow slowly softens
Every worry fades away
You're the calm within my heartbeat
The one who holds my days
And when I tremble, when I wander
When I lose my way again
Your love gathers all my pieces
Teaching broken hearts to mend
And I find you in the gentle things
In the tears I cry, in the hope you bring
You are near me in the quiet truth
Every time I fall apart you pull me through
And I know I'm safe and new
Here where my heart finds you
Every memory you've carried
Every tear you've seen me hide
You're the one who sits beside me
When I'm drowning deep inside
You turn sorrow into softness
Lift the coldness from my bones
You remind me I am cherished
I am never walking alone
So when the winds begin their shaking
And my fear begins to rise
You breathe peace into the chaos
Till the storm inside me dies
And I find you
In the gentle things
In the tears I cry
In the hope you bring
You are near me
In the quiet truth
Every time I fall apart
You pull me through
And I know I'm safe and new
Here where my heart finds you
You're the warmth inside the winter You're the fire in the rain
You're the hand that lifts my spirit When I can't lift it again
You're the song beneath my breathing You're the light behind my eyes
You're the love that never leaves me out
The one who hears my sighs
And I find you in the gentle things
In the tears I cry, in the hope you bring
You are me in the quiet truth
Every time I fall apart, you pull me through
Hearing all you say and do
My heart finds home
Ooh
Thank you.
